Instrument: Prophy Cup & Paste

Functions: To polish the coronal surfaces of teeth after scaling and debridement, and to prepare tooth surfaces before certain operative procedures such as sealant placement or bonding.

Characteristics: Available in different cup and point shapes; used with fluoridated or non-fluoridated prophylaxis pastes that vary in grit (fine, medium, coarse). Disposable or reusable; attaches to a prophy angle.

Instrument: Fluoride Varnish

Functions: To decrease post-cleaning sensitivity, remineralize incipient carious lesions, and provide caries prevention by delivering a high concentration of fluoride to the tooth surface.

Characteristics: Differs in color and flavor; sticky resin-based formula that adheres to enamel. Some patients may be allergic to the resin component. Sets quickly on contact with saliva; patient should avoid eating hard foods for several hours after application.

Instrument: Patient Tooth Brush

Functions: To allow the patient to continue effective oral home care between dental visits, reinforcing plaque removal techniques taught during the appointment.

Characteristics: Soft-bristle toothbrush recommended for most patients to prevent gingival trauma and enamel abrasion. Available in manual and powered versions; head size and handle design vary for patient comfort and access.

Instrument: Patient Floss

Functions: To allow the patient to continue effective interproximal plaque removal at home, reaching areas the toothbrush cannot access.

Characteristics: Available in waxed or non-waxed varieties; waxed slides more easily through tight contacts. Also comes in flavored, tape, and floss pick forms. Proper technique instruction should be provided at each appointment.

Instrument: Prophy Angle

Functions: To hold and rotate the prophy cup or brush during coronal polishing, enabling efficient removal of extrinsic stain and plaque from all accessible tooth surfaces.

Characteristics: Attaches to a handpiece; disposable or reusable. Accepts a prophy cup or brush tip; speed controlled by the handpiece.
